# SQL Patterns: mp_user.dim_shop__reg_s0_live

## Common WHERE Filters

```sql
-- Most common pattern (~80% of queries): local timezone, single region, yesterday
WHERE grass_date = '${BIZ_YESTERDAY}'
  AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND tz_type = 'local'

-- Without tz_type (some workflows)
WHERE grass_date = '${BIZ_PRE_DAY}'
  AND grass_region IN ('ID','MY','PH','SG','TH','TW','VN','BR')

-- Filter active shops (target audience pipelines)
WHERE grass_date = date'${yesterday}'
  AND tz_type = 'local'
  AND status = 1
  AND user_status = 1

-- Filter official shops only (brand ads)
WHERE grass_date = '${BIZ_PRE_DAY}'
  AND is_official_shop = 1

-- Filter newly created shops (cold start analysis)
WHERE grass_date = '${grass_date}'
  AND tz_type = 'local'
  AND to_unixtime(cast(create_datetime as timestamp)) - to_unixtime(cast(grass_date as timestamp)) > 0
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

```sql
-- Pattern 1: JOIN on shop_id + grass_region (most common, ~60% of JOINs)
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT shop_id, is_official_shop, is_preferred_shop, is_managed_shop, grass_region
    FROM mp_user.dim_shop__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}') AND grass_date = '${BIZ_YESTERDAY}'
) ds ON main.shop_id = ds.shop_id AND main.grass_region = ds.grass_region

-- Pattern 2: JOIN on user_id + grass_region (dim_advertiser workflow)
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT user_id, status AS shop_status, create_datetime AS shop_create_datetime,
           modify_datetime AS shop_modify_datetime, grass_region
    FROM mp_user.dim_shop__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}') AND grass_date = '${BIZ_YESTERDAY}'
) shop ON ads_account.user_id = shop.user_id AND ads_account.grass_region = shop.grass_region

-- Pattern 3: JOIN on shop_id only (shop name enrichment)
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT shop_id, shop_name
    FROM mp_user.dim_shop__reg_s0_live
    WHERE tz_type = 'local' AND grass_region = 'BR' AND grass_date = '${grass_date}'
) b ON a.shopid = b.shop_id

-- Pattern 4: INNER JOIN for base population (effective shops)
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT shop_id
    FROM mp_user.dim_shop__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}') AND grass_date = date'${yesterday}'
      AND tz_type = 'local' AND status = 1 AND user_status = 1
) a ON ...

-- Pattern 5: As base table (enumerate all shops)
SELECT DISTINCT shop_id, grass_region
FROM mp_user.dim_shop__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date = '${prev2}' AND tz_type = 'local'
  AND grass_region IN ('ID','MY','PH','SG','TH','TW','VN','BR')
```

## Common Aggregations

This is a dimension table — typically used in JOINs, not aggregated directly. Occasional patterns:

```sql
-- Count shops by seller type (cold start / reporting)
SELECT seller_type, COUNT(shop_id) AS new_shop_num
FROM (...dim_shop with CASE WHEN seller classification...)
GROUP BY seller_type, grass_date, grass_region

-- Count distinct shops (as base population)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT shop_id) FROM mp_user.dim_shop__reg_s0_live WHERE ...
```

## Representative SQL Snippets

### Snippet 1: dim_advertiser enrichment (shop attributes for advertiser dim)

```sql
-- From: data_paidadsmart/workflows/data_warehouse_us/dim/dim_advertiser__reg_s0_live
-- Two separate subqueries on dim_shop: one for user_id→shop mapping, one for shop flags
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT user_id, status AS shop_status,
           create_datetime AS shop_create_datetime,
           modify_datetime AS shop_modify_datetime, grass_region
    FROM mp_user.dim_shop__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}') AND grass_date = '${BIZ_YESTERDAY}'
) shop ON ads_account.user_id = shop.user_id

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT shop_id, is_official_shop, is_preferred_shop,
           is_managed_shop AS is_managed_seller, grass_region
    FROM mp_user.dim_shop__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}') AND grass_date = '${BIZ_YESTERDAY}'
) ds ON advertiser.shop_id = ds.shop_id
```

### Snippet 4: Seller type classification

```sql
-- From: mkplpaidads_discovery_ads/scheduled_tasks/zhaole/cold_start (and similar)
CASE WHEN is_official_shop = 1 THEN 'Official Store'
     WHEN is_cb_shop = 1 THEN 'Cross Border'
     WHEN is_managed_seller = 1 THEN 'Managed Seller'
     WHEN is_preferred_plus_shop = 1 THEN 'Preferred Plus Seller'
     WHEN is_preferred_shop = 1 THEN 'Preferred Seller'
     ELSE 'Others'
END AS seller_type
```
